title: TraceLite: Efficient Trace Reduction for SWE Agents via Optical Compression and Redundancy Removal
abstract: arXiv:2610.28612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software engineering agents solve repository-level tasks through iterative tool use, but their continuously growing interaction traces incur substantial token consumption and inference overhead. Existing compression approaches often require model training, auxiliary LLM calls, or assumptions about specific content such as source code. We present TraceLite, a simple yet effective, training-free framework for compressing heterogeneous SWE-agent observations. Our preliminary study shows that optical rendering preserves substantial textual and semantic information under moderate compression, while agent trajectories exhibit both cross-step and phase-level redundancy. Motivated by these findings, TraceLite preserves recent observations as high-fidelity text, renders historical observations as compact images, removes overlapping content, and discards phase-expired observation payloads after code editing. translated_title: TraceLite：通过光学压缩与冗余消除实现软件工程智能体的高效轨迹缩减
translated_abstract: 软件工程智能体通过迭代式工具调用解决仓库级任务，但其持续增长的交互轨迹会带来大量的token消耗和推理开销。现有的压缩方法通常需要模型训练、辅助LLM调用，或对源代码等特定内容的假设。我们提出了TraceLite，一个简单而有效的、无需训练的异构SWE智能体观测内容压缩框架。我们的初步研究表明，在适度压缩下光学渲染能够保留大量文本与语义信息，同时智能体轨迹存在跨步骤和阶段级别的冗余。受这些发现启发，TraceLite将近期观测保留为高保真文本，将历史观测渲染为紧凑的图像，移除重叠内容，并在代码编辑后丢弃已过期的阶段观测载荷。它既不需要离线训练，也无需辅助LLM调用。
tldr: TraceLite是一个无需训练的SWE智能体轨迹压缩框架，它将近期观测保留为文本、把历史观测光学渲染为紧凑图像、消除重叠与过期冗余内容，从而在保留关键信息的同时大幅降低token消耗与推理开销。
en_tdlr: TraceLite is a training-free trace compression framework for SWE agents that preserves recent observations as text, renders historical observations as compact images via optical compression, removes overlapping and phase-expired redundant content, thereby substantially reducing token consumption and inference overhead while retaining key information.
